SELECT add_provenance('partsupp');
SELECT set_prob(provenance(), prob) FROM partsupp;
CREATE VIEW german_supplier AS SELECT DISTINCT t0.c1 AS c1 FROM supplier t0, nation t1 WHERE t1.c1 = t0.c2 AND t1.c2 = 'germany';
CREATE VIEW q11_part AS SELECT DISTINCT t0.c1 AS c1 FROM partsupp t0, german_supplier t1 WHERE t1.c1 = t0.c2;
CREATE VIEW q11 AS SELECT DISTINCT 1 AS c1 FROM q11_part t0;
